glosses: das Alte Testament der Bibel betreffend

examples.text: „Die alttestamentlichen Berufungsgeschichten stellen eine formgeschichtliche Gattung dar, deren Inhalt die Berufung einer Person durch Gott zu einem bestimmten Verkündigungsauftrag ist.“
„Im 8. bis 10. Jahrhundert lassen sich fast nur alttestamentliche Namen nachweisen.“

translations.source_sense_description: das Alte Testament der Bibel betreffend

glosses: The first major part of the Christian Bible, covering events before the coming of Christ, corresponding roughly to the Jewish Tanakh. Usually subdivided into the categories of law, history, poetry (or wisdom books), and prophecy.

examples.text: The Old Testament says that eating shellfish is a sin.

glosses: Reminiscent of the content of the Old Testament, or of the behavior of God in it; especially dramatic, violent or vengeful.

examples.text: Given the Old Testament weather that defines the country, it's little wonder that religious faith became the cornerstone of the land and the people who stayed. I've seen hailstorms and tornadoes roll in over those fields with no more warning than God allowed Job
"Walter is a peaceful man, but I have a feeling that when it comes to you, he could get Old Testament."
"So we hate this girl who has information about the slime ball who took pictures of you. The enemy of our enemy. Totally Old Testament. Got it."
